properties.site-address: Edenbridge & District War Memorial Hospital, Mill Hill, Edenbridge
properties.notes: Emerging Local Plan Ref ST2-32 - Redevelopment of site subject to confirmation of health commissioning requirements in relation to the current uses. Replacement facilities to serve the local community to be provided as part of any redevelopment scheme. A heritage assessment is to be submitted as part of any planning application and mitigation measures are required to soften the impact on the setting of the conservation area and nearby listed buildings. Retain existing trees and hedges
